data.exact_reserve_text: Change in prior year provisions for 2019 Gross: 14,053 (GBP '000).
data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate experienced a gross prior year reserve strengthening of GBP 14.1 million. This was primarily due to adverse claims development and IBNR recalibration. However, significant reinsurance recoveries, particularly from a 50% quota share agreement with Cavello Bay Reinsurance Limited, led to a substantial net prior year release of GBP 597.5 million.
raw_causal_phrases: Positive movements on claims incurred net of reinsurance are driven predominately by increased reinsurance recoveries due to the Cavello Bay 50% quota share.

The measurement of the provision for claims outstanding involves judgments and assumptions about the future that have the most significant effect on the amounts recognised in the financial statements.
The amount included in respect of IBNR is based on statistical techniques of estimation applied by the Syndicate Managing agent's in-house actuaries and is reviewed by external consulting actuaries.

gross_premium_mix.line_of_business: Fire and other damage to property

data.data_quality_notes: The claims development triangle on page 17 is highly sparse and appears distorted by significant Reinsurance to Close (RITC) transactions, making it unsuitable for calculating prior year development. The gross prior year development by line of business is not provided, only net figures are available.
